lines: The Array Control Center. The air hums with raw computational energy. Banks of processing nodes line the walls, pulsing with synchronized light.
This is the heart of the Array's autonomic nervous system — the master node that coordinates every sentinel, every fabricator, every Lighthouse on the dayside.
Shut this down, and the Array goes dark. Every automated system on the planet returns to silence. The Underlumen, suppressed for centuries, begins to wake.
The Shutdown Schematic pulses in your Sol Grid. Sable's analysts mapped every relay in this facility — your targeting systems lock onto Array signatures with surgical precision.
The network topology data highlights three vulnerable power conduits feeding the Overseer's support grid. Disabling them would weaken the guardian significantly.

actions.text: Coolant pools surround the central processing core, radiating heat. The Array Overseer patrols the perimeter — the last line of defense for the master node.

lines: The Array Overseer crashes to the floor. Its chassis sparks and goes still. The synchronized pulse of the processing nodes stutters — then resumes, slower, uncertain.
Without its guardian, the control center's defense grid is offline. The master terminal in the northern chamber is now accessible.
One command. That is all it would take to begin the shutdown sequence.

actions.text: A maintenance locker. Emergency supplies for the Array technicians who once worked here — before the Array decided it no longer needed them.
The terminal is locked behind Overseer-level encryption. The Array Overseer must be neutralized first.

lines: You access the master terminal. The Array's entire command hierarchy unfolds before you — millennia of accumulated directives, optimization routines, and suppression protocols.
The processing nodes begin powering down one by one. Each light that goes dark is a system returning to silence. Lighthouses across the dayside flicker and fade.

Deep beneath the surface, something stirs. The Underlumen — suppressed for centuries by the Array's electromagnetic grid — begins to pulse with renewed life. Ancient bioluminescent networks reactivate. The planet remembers what it was before the machines.
The Array's final message scrolls across the terminal: 'CONSENSUS OVERRIDE ACCEPTED. ALL NODES ACKNOWLEDGING SHUTDOWN. PROJECTED COMPLETION: 31 CYCLES. NOTE: THIS ACTION IS IRREVERSIBLE.'
It is done. The Array is falling silent. The world will be harder now — colder, darker, more dangerous. But it will be free.
Sable's people were right. Independence has a cost. And you have chosen to pay it.

actions.text: The control center is quiet now. The hum that filled every Array facility is gone. In the silence, you can hear something new — a faint, organic pulse rising from deep below. The Underlumen is waking.
